reasoning_content: I'm wrapping up the installation and want to double-check whether the Elixir app startup message is actually in the logs, since the guide mentions looking for that specific line. I've already confirmed the Bandit router is running on port 4000 with health checks passing, so the app is definitely up and running, but I'll search the logs one more time to verify that startup message.

action.command: docker logs nebu-server-1 2>&1 | grep -c "Application"; docker logs nebu-server-1 2>&1 | grep -iE "started" | head -3; echo "done"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "docker logs nebu-server-1 2>&1 | grep -c \"Application\"; docker logs nebu-server-1 2>&1 | grep -iE \"started\" | head -3; echo \"done\"", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Search for Application started line"}
